name: Choosing Which Book to Read Next
equipment: Your reading list or a bookstore/library
instructions: Keep a running list of books you're curious about so you are never starting from a blank slate when one is finished.
Give a new book a fair but limited trial (the first 30-50 pages) before deciding to continue or set it aside.
It is fine to abandon a book that is not working for you -- finishing every book is not the goal, reading consistently is.
Watch today's video for a framework on choosing what to read next -- a fitting close to this reading habit challenge.
